messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman faces the camera and slowly smiles, with subtle head and facial movement.","camera":"A front-facing medium close-up that gradually tightens into a close-up on her face.","clothing":"A bright pink off-the-shoulder top is visible at the bottom of the frame.","hair_color":"Light brown with darker brown buns.","hairstyle":"Light brown hair with straight bangs and two high space buns on either side of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with a medium-brown complexion, visible facial freckles, and a slight smile that widens over time.","scene":"A dark futuristic interior with a large glass dome, pink structural beams, glowing circular light rings, and a reflective floor."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's side-view full-body walking shot with a front-facing medium close-up that gradually tightens on the woman's face. The same futuristic dome scene and pink top are visible, and the character now faces the camera with a slowly widening smile.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial framing, while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial movement and smile progression are intended preserved action or newly generated motion.
Whether the character's identity and facial features remain exactly consistent with the source under the new front-facing angle.
unexpected_changes: The source action of walking across the scene is no longer visible; the character appears mostly stationary facing the camera.
The character's expression changes from a neutral side profile to a gradually widening smile.
The clothing appears as an off-the-shoulder pink top in the close-up, whereas the source showed a fitted pink top with a white skirt.
